tools.name: revise_ui_pack_png

tools.name: rename_ui_component

tools.name: save_ui_component_defaults

tools.name: replace_ui_component_png

tools.name: create_ui_composition

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_sync, get_character, list_character_poses, get_asset, get_job, get_export_command, approve_directional_poses, generate_character_animation, generate_character_turn, convert_texture_to_material, get_ui_pack, get_ui_pack_batch_recovery, get_ui_pack_batch · Private data: get_integration_status, whoami, get_credits, list_characters, plan_sync, get_character_manifest, get_frames, export_map, generate_character_animation, revise_asset, create_asset, import_asset_image · Public sink: get_credits, reprocess_asset, generate_character_animation, create_asset, import_asset_image · Destructive: plan_sync, get_frames, get_export_command, select_frames, cancel_job, reprocess_asset, generate_character_animation, generate_character_turn, animate_asset, revise_asset, regen_asset_pair, fix_asset_seams, create_asset, retry_job, import_asset_image, generate_ui_pack, revise_ui_pack_png, get_ui_pack_export_command.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_sync, get_character, list_character_poses, get_asset, get_job, get_export_command, approve_directional_poses, generate_character_animation, generate_character_turn, convert_texture_to_material, get_ui_pack, get_ui_pack_batch_recovery, get_ui_pack_batch · Private data: get_integration_status, whoami, get_credits, list_characters, plan_sync, get_character_manifest, get_frames, export_map, generate_character_animation, revise_asset, create_asset, import_asset_image · Public sink: get_credits, reprocess_asset, generate_character_animation, create_asset, import_asset_image · Destructive: plan_sync, get_frames, get_export_command, select_frames, cancel_job, reprocess_asset, generate_character_animation, generate_character_turn, animate_asset, revise_asset, regen_asset_pair, fix_asset_seams, create_asset, retry_job, import_asset_image, generate_ui_pack, revise_ui_pack_png, get_ui_pack_export_command

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
